name: Mappy
storyline: The player controls Mappy, who must retrieve birthday gifts for Mapico, which were stolen by the "Guchi Gang" (presumably this is Goro and the Meowkies). This summary is similar to World 1 of Mappy-Land.
summary: The Mappy LCD Game is a handheld game released in 1992 by Micro Games of America (MGA). Rather than being a direct port, It features a mixture of elements from Mappy and Mappy-Land.
